entries.0aebbae946159c43: Coconala Pro is a service that matches high-end talent with companies under their real names, while Coconala Consult matches high-end consultants in fields such as management, business development and marketing with companies.
entries.270d575a2d1985d7: This is a service that matches personnel who perform business support tasks, such as clerical, secretarial, accounting, human resources and customer support work, on a time-based billing basis for only the hours needed.
entries.296f598270c83d2c: This is a matching site where users can find a suitable lawyer for everyday worries and troubles and consult or request services from them. The company receives fixed usage fees, based on a prescribed fee schedule, from registered lawyers.
entries.4cd02186b7c66005: Individuals and corporations that purchase content
entries.4e51823cbb9f744a: This segment centers on the skill marketplace Coconala Skill Market, where services based on individuals' knowledge, skills and experience are bought and sold. The consolidated subsidiary Mizuho Coconala Co., Ltd. provides services to corporate customers of Mizuho Bank. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥5,720 million.
entries.4e63a26df24d748f: A company that operates a marketplace where individuals can buy and sell knowledge, skills and experience, and an agent service that connects professional talent with companies.
entries.7a86c31d5d467d8f: Individuals and corporations that purchase skills and content
entries.7c38039ddb74f882: This is a platform on which digital content such as articles, images, illustrations, videos and audio can be sold and purchased without the need to attract customers. It launched in April 2025, and cumulative listings have surpassed 30,000.
entries.a2f971daa63b116c: Coconala Recruitment is a service in which buyers publish the deliverables or outsourced work they want and recruit those who are willing to respond. Coconala Scout is a service that enables companies to search for professional talent among more than 1,200,000 registrants and approach them directly; it launched in April 2025.
entries.c88f5fe553e5f81d: This segment matches IT freelancers and high-end talent with companies through an outsourcing contract format in which coconala is the contracting party. The consolidated subsidiary Coconala Tech Co., Ltd. provides the Coconala Tech service. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥3,690 million.
entries.cda6a166324ac58c: This is a matching service that connects IT freelance talent with companies' outsourcing projects. It is operated by the consolidated subsidiary Coconala Tech Co., Ltd.
entries.d115703a1014c57b: Individuals and companies wishing to commission work
entries.d185c1fe368cc487: Individuals and businesses that list content
entries.d8f83cf54cb1928d: Individuals and businesses that list skills
entries.de06b1173d97221b: Companies wishing to use outsourced personnel
entries.fbc27853f09fd115: This is a marketplace where users list their own knowledge, skills and experience, and buyers can select and purchase them. As of the end of August 2025, the number of listed services was approximately 1,000,000, and the number of registered skill providers exceeded 1,200,000. Upon completion of service provision, the company receives 20% from the seller and 5% from the buyer as standard fees.
entries.fec9cf1e4237a3d4: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and it includes investment business. No revenue from external customers is recorded for the current consolidated fiscal year.
